title: Prisoner jumps to his death
article: The RCMP has launched an investigation into how a prisoner jumped out of a small plane, flying over open water off B.C.'s north coast on Thursday afternoon.
There were six passengers aboard the Harbour Air float plane enroute from the Queen Charlotte Islands to Prince Rupert, when 46-year-old Donald Bigg managed to open the cabin door and leap out.

Eric Rempel is the Prince Rupert pilot who was flying the plane. "There was a scream behind me, and I looked, and this fellow forced the door," he says. "He was out the door. At first I didn't know what the heck was going on, but then I clued in it was a suicide."
The Prince Rupert RCMP says Bigg was handcuffed and under the supervision of provincial sheriffs at the time.
Coast Guard spokesperson John Palliser says a helicopter and two search and rescue boats spent several hours searching for Bigg in the waters off Prince Rupert. He is now presumed dead.
The search was called off after 9 p.m. Thursday. Police have not said why Bigg was in custody and being transferred to Prince Rupert.
